changes_made.explanation: GPT-4o is used for data preprocessing and error generation, not as a judge/evaluator of generated outputs. The paper does not use LLMs as judges.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on multimodal knowledge conflicts in document understanding, specifically evaluating consistency between OCR (perception) and VQA (cognition) tasks. While GPT-4o is used extensively for data preprocessing and error generation, it is not used as a judge/evaluator of generated outputs. The automatic metrics (ANLS, F1, Relaxed Accuracy) are used to evaluate model performance on cognitive and perceptual tasks.
